# Satis Group

> Satis Group (RA Developments (NW) Limited) is a property development
> company based in Cheshire, England. It acquires, redevelops and manages
> residential and commercial property across the North West of England —
> 60+ properties redeveloped and £120m in gross development value delivered.
> Tagline: Reviving the past. Building the future.

## Developments

- [Portfolio](https://www.satisgroup.co.uk/portfolio): all current and completed developments
- [The Courthouse](https://www.satisgroup.co.uk/portfolio/the-courthouse): 13 apartments in the converted 1934 Macclesfield courthouse, for sale
- [Hazelgate](https://www.satisgroup.co.uk/portfolio/hazelgate): 19 new apartments in Hazel Grove, Stockport
- [Barrington House](https://www.satisgroup.co.uk/portfolio/barrington-house): residences to let in Altrincham
- [22 St John](https://www.satisgroup.co.uk/portfolio/22-st-john): 13 private office suites in a Grade II listed Georgian building, Manchester
- [Petersgate House](https://www.satisgroup.co.uk/portfolio/petersgate-house): 58 apartments and two commercial units, Stockport (completed)
